text.p: Former Sussex paceman Ed Giddins, banned for 20 months after testing positive for cocaine, has signed a three-year contract to play for Warwickshire from the start of the 1998 season.
Giddins, 25, lost an appeal against the ban, imposed after he tested positive during a random test while playing for Sussex against Kent at Tunbridge Wells last May.

"We believe that Ed is a high class bowler and a player who will strengthen Warwickshire's squad," Warwickshire chief executive Dennis Amiss said on Monday. "We look forward to seeing him with us for the 1998 season.''
